== English errata comparison sources ==
The dated 2016 announcement limits drain cancellation to adjacent Death Star or Executor sites. It and the June 2017 slip say “on” in the deployment clause. Appendix A and the full face say “to” and retain the same destinations.

Aglets, Players Committee Rules Advocate, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1036946#p1036946 Dainsom errata announcement], 31 May 2016, effective immediately. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=4 Decipher Errata], PDF page 4. Players Committee, Appendix A, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=117 2023 Advanced Rulebook], PDF page 117.
